response.sql: WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), shares AS (SELECT order_id, invoice_count, invoice_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS invoice_share FROM invoice_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(s.invoice_share) AS average_share, AVG(s.invoice_share - a.value) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.invoice_share > a.value
